meta.title: Refactor EngineTests to use DataDescription::getCellRef instead of helper methods
meta.body_summary: Refactor 15 EngineTests files to use direct DataDescription::getCellRef instead of helper methods getCell/getCellById, claiming more efficient cell access without intermediate maps.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot bulk refactor completed but targeted wrong branch (develop vs v5.0_dev); maintainer closed without merge due to branch policy.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 768 changed lines across 15 test files, this is a medium-sized mechanical refactor by absolute volume. The PR was closed due to a branch-target mismatch, not the scale of the change, so the outcome is consistent with process rather than code quality or risk.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer chrxh requested the refactor be applied to the v5.0_dev branch, not the develop branch, indicating the PR was opened against the wrong base.
review_details.performance_claim: Direct cell access via getCellRef without intermediate maps is more efficient and reduces line count.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by maintainer after branch-target correction was requested; no further commits occurred.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot successfully performed a large mechanical refactoring across 15 files, but the agent lacked knowledge of the repository's branching policy (v5.0_dev vs develop). The boundary is procedural rather than technical.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer noticed the PR was based on the wrong branch (develop) and requested a switch to v5.0_dev.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks, profiling, or timing data were provided. The efficiency gain is a claim in the PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR was closed without merge after the branch-target request. No performance regression was discussed.

core_change_summary.description: In 15 test files under source/EngineTests/, replaced calls to IntegrationTestFramework::getCell and getCellById with DataDescription::getCellRef, eliminating intermediate maps. Made getCellRef public in Descriptions.h.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Visibility change: moved getCellRef to public to enable direct test access.
change_trajectory: Single large commit (7d3ad11) applied the bulk replacement across all test files and the header.

review_signals.summary: Requested that the refactor be made on the v5.0_dev branch rather than develop.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot responded that it switched branches, but the PR was closed anyway.

review_signals.summary: Stated that work was switched to v5.0_dev and that the refactor already existed there.

collaboration_trajectory: PR opened targeted at develop branch with bulk refactor.
Maintainer commented to use v5.0_dev instead.
PR closed by maintainer with no merge.
